subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Tundra — structured parsing of clinical assessment & plan text
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing for Tundra: Yara leads at 65%, Wei 45% on the AP-parsing task and eval, Bilal 40% on the Beam data-generation pipeline.

Compute: modest, 16 A100s best-effort. The Beam job for TF example generation is the wall-clock cost, not training.

Blocker to flag now: vocabulary. Because the vocabulary contains note data, it can't be distributed with the code — we have to generate our own from our licensed corpus. The repo ships only a sample_vocab.txt. Bilal estimates a week once access clears, and access is gated on Privacy Review, which is a 2-3 week SLA. Filing this week.

Deshawn
